selection.algorithm: FNV-1a 32-bit over seed|family_key, ascending; whole eligible family groups until >=105 rated completed items; group based on named franchise patterns or first-three-token prefix plus union of full-title-prefix relations across all 778 MAL records
selection.franchise_grouping: Union-find across all anime statuses: named-franchise regex, normalized first three words, and complete-title prefix matches; selection key is alphabetically first normalized title plus minimum MAL ID
selection.exclude_from_test: answered questions, explicit qualitative evidence, known prior conversational examples, partial briefs, and their detected title families
selection.rule: No score-stratification and no score-based manual swaps; one pre-prediction quality repair to enforce franchise isolation.

warnings: Full anime.json and other originals contain all scores: never expose source repo, library, web, memory, or existing MAL-derived statistics to the prediction model.
Group assignment is a title-heuristic, not a verified MAL franchise graph; treat accidental related-work crossover as a methodological risk.
All scores except 1-4 are highly imbalanced; use performance stratified by actual score after predictions are locked.
preflight_revision: 1.0.1 – fixed 9 title-prefix cross-split franchise violations before any model predictions
